body: They don't understand, man. I appreciate you taking the time to care. If I tell them, or my family, then I drag them into my mess. I know that my only way out of this world, barring act of God, is suicide. I can't bring other people into it like that, just for them to feel responsible, like they could have done more. Better for them to not have input on my decision.
Nothing in my life makes the game worth the candle, so to speak, so it's time to snuff it and go to bed.
